concerns.text: Task T007c (TDP Calibration) is marked as incomplete/missing in the current state (checkbox unchecked), yet it is a hard dependency for T026 (Energy Metrics) and SC-002 (Computational Overhead). Without a task to generate `data/processed/calibrated_tdp.json`, the energy calculation requirement cannot be satisfied.

Task T013c (Validate Distribution) is marked as incomplete. It is required to verify the dataset meets FR-001 (parseable formal language) and SC-001 (statistical power) prerequisites. Its dependency on T013d (which is also incomplete) creates a blockage for the entire US1 validation chain.

Task T026 (Implement Metrics) is marked as incomplete. It is the primary task for SC-002 (Energy Consumption) and FR-004. It depends on T007c (missing artifact) and T005b. Without this task, the project cannot measure the computational cost required to compare symbolic vs. neural baselines.

Task T029b (Scalability Analysis) is marked as incomplete. It is the sole task addressing SC-005 (Complexity Class Characterization). Without this task, the project cannot determine the Big-O complexity of the symbolic approach, leaving a key success criterion unfulfilled.

Task T031b (Generate Final Report) is marked as incomplete. It is the final output for US3 and aggregates all results for SC-001 through SC-005. Its dependencies (T027, T029b, T030d) are also blocked or incomplete, leaving the entire analysis phase without a deliverable.

Task T040b (Document Empirical Calibration Impossibility) is marked as incomplete. It is required to satisfy Constitution Principle VII (Computational Efficiency Benchmarking) by providing the literature-based conversion factor for GPU-hours. Without this, the plan's 'PARTIALLY SATISFIED' status cannot be resolved to 'PASS'.
